mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 69 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall. Tonight features a waxing crescent moon, and the space station will be visible from 7:36 PM for five minutes, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and heading northeast toward Madison. The overnight low will be 57 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the police department recently released their recap of service calls from August 31 to September 14, which included a burglary on Hunters Cove Way and an O W I crash on Shooting Star Road.
There is plenty to do in Verona, with Hop Haus Trivia and Lake Lou-ee Trivia held today, and tomorrow offering the farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and live music at Paddy Mac's.
One notable incident occurred on September 5, when officers investigated multiple vehicles that had slices of cheese placed on their windshields as part of a viral social media prank.
Please note that Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
